{{Quote|SWEET SPOT LODGING&mdash;CORE WORLDS STYLING AT OUTER RIM RATES.|Sign above the hostel entrance|<ref name="Mercy Kill">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref>}}
'''Sweet Spot Lodging''' was a [[Hotel/Legends|hostel]] located within the [[Blueshift Passage]] on [[Gagrew Station]], a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] located within the [[Si'Klaata Cluster/Legends|Si'Klaata Cluster]] in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]].<ref name="Mercy Kill" />

In [[44 ABY]], <ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> members of [[Wraith Squadron]], a [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit, stayed at the hostel before boarding the ''[[Bastion Princess]]''.<ref name="Mercy Kill" />
